train_convnext_model: train a ConvNeXt model for image classification using argparse CLI with configurable batch size, epochs, and learning rate
evaluate_convnext_model: evaluate a trained ConvNeXt model on a validation dataset using the --eval flag with --finetune checkpoint path
finetune_convnext_from_checkpoint: finetune a ConvNeXt model from a pretrained checkpoint using --finetune with --model_key to select state dict key
configure_convnext_augmentation: configure mixup and cutmix augmentation for ConvNeXt training using --mixup, --cutmix, and --mixup_prob CLI arguments
run_convnext_distributed_training: run distributed ConvNeXt training across multiple GPUs using --dist_url and --world_size with gradient accumulation
